lines.t: My God, Yahushua, my soul longs for you
With your majesty before my face
How can I look elsewhere?
Oh my God
You are so wonderful in all your ways
As I cling to you, my beloved, please, please cling to me
Keep my feet from slipping, keep my face from turning
Hold me in your strong embrace
Correct me, discipline me, teach me
Show me my sins so I may flee from them
Help me to stand before you with a heart that reflects your own
Let your glory shine before my eyes
And let the glory of this world fade
You are my glory, you are my hope and my life
Thank you for soothing me in your peace
Without this I know I would be swallowed up in grief
Longing for my bridegroom
Even so, my heart sings
It sings a song of love and devotion to my King
It sings of praise and glory to my almighty God
It sings of the day my blessed hope returns for me
With joyful expectation
Keep me, my love, my God
Wash me in your blood and your tears again and again
Let me stand in your blood until you lift me up
A continual cleansing so I will never be found
Defiled or unworthy before your face
Look upon me, Father, your own creation made for you
May I fulfill all your desires for me
Show me how to please you with all my way
May I reflect your joy and your love onto you
Fill my mouth and my heart with perfect praise
Walk with me, hold my hand
As if we walk together in your garden already
I will wait, my Lord, with patient endurance by your strength
Come, Lord, Yahushua, come
Your bride waits you
Thank you.
